text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and three reasons in opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a focused claim up front and maps out its reasons in a way that structures the argument clearly."},{"evidence":"uses Google's \"half a million miles without a crash\" to support claims","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay brings in specific details from the article and ties them directly to its position."},{"evidence":"explains how driverless cars would reduce drunk-driving and human error","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"The essay develops its points by showing how the article's facts lead to broader consequences rather than just stating opinions."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs each develop one main reason","quality":"paragraph development","description":"The essay sustains each supporting point with a fuller explanation instead of moving quickly from one idea to the next."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of the three reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by summarizing its argument in a way that reinforces the central claim."}]}
